Subject: Post-webinar attendee reconciliation, SDR claims & APAC-friendly follow-up windows

Thanks team — quick handoff from the "Scaling Inference" webinar we co-sponsored with CloudTech yesterday. Attached are three artifacts: the raw attendee export, a scored attendee list (basic MQL scoring we ran), and the replay link (text file with the canonical URL).

High-level asks (short):
- SDRs: please claim accounts you plan to contact by EOD Monday PT. Use the claim column in the attached CSV and add your initials.
- Prioritization: focus on accounts with Score >= 70 first; within those, check the "org_size" and "active_trial" flags.
- APAC cadence: for accounts in APAC (TZ: JST/AEST/SGT) propose a 8am-11am local window for first outreach. If you need info to localize times I can batch-send templates.
- External follow-ups: Aisha/Tom — we shared the deck and the replay to sponsors; please let us know if there are partners who want an intro thread.

Attachments: 20270521-webinar-attendees-raw.csv (export), 20270521-attendee-scores.csv (MQL scoring + claim column), replay-20270521.txt (canonical replay URL + UTMs).

I'll be tracking claims in the Drive sheet at the link below; if anyone hits data issues ping me and I'll reconcile.

Drive folder: https://drive.company.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-webinar-20270521
Replay: https://events-platform.com/replay/7f3b2

Thanks —
Maya Srinivasan
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
